title: ErasureRequest
description: Erase a person's data (GDPR Art 17, FR-309). The client chooses the id and sends the same request to every service; repeating it returns the stored proof.

reason.description: Why, for example the reference of the data subject's request.

redactEntries.description: Knowledge service only: entry revisions whose title and body are themselves personal data. They and every revision derived from them are redacted.
